Once you’ve agreed upon the internship goals, both managers should inform their respective groups’ People Business Partner.

## Recommendations

We recommend that, at any given time, each [team](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/structure/) is handling only one intern. This is to allow for an efficient and focused mentorship without impacting the capacity of the team. You can, of course, adjust this depending on the size of the team but please consider the impact of mentoring when scheduling internships.

records.question: 劳动合同模板需要修改，以及已入职员工咨询自己的合同，分别应该找谁？模板修改需要谁批准，个人合同问题从哪里提交？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

合同模板由 **Legal, Employment 团队**负责。模板修改建议或请求应提交给该团队，并需要 **VP of Legal, Employment** 批准。[1]

已入职员工的个人合同由 **People Operations 团队**负责，合同问题通过 **Compass ticket** 提交，由该团队按需处理或升级。[1]

content: The DRI for all contract templates is the Legal, Employment team. Contracts are audited and updated on a regular basis. Any suggestions or requests for changes to employment templates should be made to the Legal, Employment team and will require approval from the VP of Legal, Employment. You can read [*how* to connect with Legal, Employment](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/legal/employment-law/#connect) in the Handbook.

The DRI for individual team member contracts (once a team member is hired) is the People Operations Team. Any queries about a team member’s contract should go to the People Operations Team by Compass ticket, and the query will be directed or escalated as appropriate.

records.question: 我接受了同职级的内部转岗，能否据此断言一定涨薪？什么情况下薪酬结构差异可能影响判断？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

不能因为接受了同职级内部转岗，就认定一定涨薪。政策说明，同职级职位通常会被视为横向调动；**大多数横向调动不会增加薪酬**，但新旧岗位族的薪酬结构存在显著差异时有例外。[1]

是否确属横向调动，还要审查新岗位的 **职级、岗位族和职责范围**。存在薪酬结构差异也不等于已经保证涨薪。[1]

content: - If a team member applies for and accepts a position at the same grade, it will most likely be considered a [lateral transfer](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/promotions-transfers/#transfer-compensation-guidelines). In most cases, a lateral transfer will not result in a compensation increase, unless there is a significant difference in the compensation structure between the new and prior job families. When a team member moves to a new role, a review of the job level, family, and scope will determine if this is indeed a lateral move.

records.question: 人才评估启动时入职不超过三个月，会被直接认定为低绩效吗？对应标记是什么？评估使用哪个系统以及哪两个维度？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

不会因此直接认定为低绩效。人才评估项目启动时，任职时长不超过三个月的团队成员会被标记为 **Too New to Rate（入职时间尚短，暂不评级）**。[1]

该评估使用 **Workday**，采用 **Performance（绩效）/ Growth Potential（成长潜力）矩阵**。暂不评级不能等同于低绩效。[1]

content: For team members with a tenure up to three months to the launch of the Talent Assessment Program will be designated as “Too New to Rate”. Also in some cases a “Too New to Rate” designation might be applicable for newly promoted or transferred team members. More about that designation can be found below.
We use Workday to complete our Talent Assessment.
There are many talent assessment options, and we have opted to use a Performance/Growth Potential Matrix (commonly known as “9-Box” in the US) and annually review Key Talent.

records.question: 导师指导关系必须严格持续六个月、只能同步开会吗？页面建议的期限与交流频率是什么？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

不是必须严格持续六个月，也不是只能同步开会。页面将以下安排列为**建议**：[1]

- 建议期限：**3—6 个月**。
- 交流频率：**每两周一次，每次 30—45 分钟**；也可以约定每两周用 30—45 分钟进行异步交流。[1]

content: Below is a suggested format for this meeting cadence:
1. Establish a timeframe: 3-6 month is suggested
2. Set a meeting cadence every other week for 30-45 minutes or agree to spend 30-45 minutes every other week communicating asynchronously

records.question: IGP每个评审周期建议聚焦多少个发展目标？Workday提醒更新计划，与和经理开展职业对话，分别是什么频率？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

IGP 指引建议，每个评审周期聚焦 **1—3 个有意义的发展目标**。[1]

两种频率应分开理解：

- **计划回顾与刷新提醒**：经理提供意见后，Workday 每 **6 个月**提醒回顾并刷新 IGP。
- **与经理的职业发展对话**：在一对一交流中，安排**至少每季度一次**。[1]

content: Focus on 1-3 meaningful development goals per review period.
Workday will remind you to review and refresh your IGP every 6 months after your manager provides input.

2. Schedule at least one quarterly [career conversation](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/career-development/#having-career-conversations) with your manager during a 1:1.

records.question: Elevate+的工作坊和个人辅导分别有几次、每次多久？只参加工作坊就能拿证吗？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

Elevate+ 包括 **5 次 Executive Discussion Workshops（高管讨论工作坊），每次 60 分钟**，以及 **6 次个人辅导，每次 60 分钟**，个人辅导可以灵活安排时间。[1]

**只参加工作坊不足以满足拿证条件。** 政策要求成功完成项目，包括出席所有必需的现场课程、参与异步学习和完成 Executive coaching sessions（高管辅导），之后才授予认证。[1]

content: 5 Executive Discussion Workshops (60 minutes each)
Individual coaching sessions (6 sessions, 60 minutes each, flexible scheduling)

Yes! Upon successful completion of the program, including attendance to all required live sessions, asynchronous learning participation, and Executive coaching sessions, participants will be awarded the GitLab Elevate+ certification.

records.question: Elevate+因个人原因缺席一次现场课，需要谁批准？补课时间如何要求，额外缺席会怎样？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

因个人原因必须缺席 **一次现场课程**时，需要获得**经理批准**。[1]

错过的课程须**在当月内补上**，以按顺序学习和推进项目。额外缺席会导致 Elevate+ 状态为 **incomplete（未完成）**。如有疑问，可联系 Learning and Development 团队。[1]

content: It’s a requirement to make up missed sessions within each month to ensure that you’re learning each new skill and moving through the program in the appropriate order. Please make every effort to attend live sessions as scheduled. Please reach out to your Learning and Development team for any questions.

We’re committed to working with you to find a solution that lets you successfully complete Elevate+. If you must miss one live session for personal reasons, you need approval from your manager. Additional missed sessions will result in an incomplete Elevate+ status.

records.question: 反骚扰政策是否只适用于正式雇员、不含承包商？经理已经知悉不当行为，但没人向PBP书面投诉，是否可以不处理？
records.answer:
根据本项目保存的 GitLab Handbook 政策快照：

政策**不限于正式雇员**：适用于所有地区的 GitLab 团队成员，包含 **contractor（承包商）和 employee（雇员）**。处理、报告和调查时，还必须遵守适用的当地法律与相应程序。[1]

经理已经知悉不当行为时，**不能因为没有向 People Business Partner 提交书面或正式投诉就不处理**。政策要求经理及时、认真、保密且公平地处理有关指控。[1]
